See AMC.973
(a) Each fuel tank filler connection must be marked as prescribed in USAR.1557 (c).
(b) Spilled fuel must be prevented from entering the fuel tank compartment or any part of the UAV other than the tank itself.
(c) Each filler cap must provide a fuel-tight seal for the main filler opening. However, there may be small openings in the fuel tank cap for venting purposes or for the purpose of allowing passage of a fuel gauge through the cap provided such openings comply with the requirements of USAR.975 (a).
(d) There must be a means to insure that there is no electrical potential difference between the fuel filling points (except the pressure fuelling connection points) and the ground fuel equipment.
(e) For UAV with engines requiring gasoline as the only permissible fuel, the inside diameter of the fuel filler opening must be no larger than 60 mm (2.36 in).
(f) For UAV with turbine engines, the inside diameter of the fuel filler opening must be no smaller than 75 mm (2.95 in).
